name: Pigment red 184
description: Pigment Red 184 (CAS 99402-80-9 ) is a high-performance organic pigment delivering a clean, bluish-red to magenta hue across demanding industrial colorant applications. It belongs to the benzimidazolone class, offering strong color strength and heat stability. In coatings and industrial paints, this pigment is specified where bright red-magenta shades with good lightfastness and overcoating resistance are required. Printing ink formulators use it in packaging applications where color consistency is critical. Plastics compounders incorporate it into polyolefin and engineering polymer systems that require processing at elevated temperatures without significant color shift. It is particularly valued for its durability in technically exacting systems. Textile and paper colorant producers also use it where a vivid, bleed-resistant red-magenta tone is needed in surface coatings or pigment printing pastes. This versatility makes it a staple in high-end industrial manufacturing. The product is supplied as a dry powder, with press cake forms available from select manufacturers. Standard commercial grades are offered at full-strength pigment concentration for maximum efficiency in formulation. Specialty dispersions and masterbatch formats are available for plastics and ink applications. Technical-grade specifications are the norm, with product performance typically defined by color strength and hue angle benchmarks. Heat stability and chemical resistance are key performance indicators for this pigment.
